label: auto-compaction
type: the background process that reclaims disk space by rewriting on-disk data files and index files, configured cluster-wide or per bucket. Applies only to on-disk data: not to Ephemeral buckets, and not to memory-optimized indexes in Enterprise Edition. The Couchstore-only settings do not appear for Magma buckets.
aliases_note: `data:auto-compaction` was minted from learn/data/expiration.md, which links to the same auto-compaction procedure page that `storage:auto-compaction`'s files describe - one process, two prefixes, and the licensing is the link itself: "The [auto-compaction](../../manage/manage-settings/configure-compact-settings.md) process runs." 6 + 1 files, zero overlap.
evidence: Auto-compaction settings affect on-disk data, and therefore do not apply to Ephemeral buckets.
In Couchbase Server Enterprise Edition, auto-compaction does not apply to memory-optimized index storage.
This setting only appears for buckets using the Couchstore storage engine. It does not appear for buckets that use the Magma storage engine.
Users with the Full or Cluster administrator roles can configure compaction settings.
note: Three independent exclusions, all stated as negatives, plus a UI fact of a kind that only a procedure can carry: a setting that DISAPPEARS from the form depending on the bucket's storage engine. An extraction that reads only reference material can learn that auto-compaction exists but cannot learn that its own configuration screen changes shape.
